title: cyperus luteus var. manongarivensis
intro: Cyperus luteus var. manongarivensis, commonly known as Manongarivo Sedge, is a plant species of the family Cyperaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Manongarivo Sedge include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's potential in treating various health conditions and its use as a medicinal plant in traditional medicine.
